 Mr. Kishore Mukherjee  Mr. Sankha Subhra Ray..........for the petitioner  Mr. Subhabrata Datta  Mr. Benazir Ahmed.................for the State  Ms. Nibedita Karmakar Bhattacharjee...

entities.text:
Sk. Moniruddin vs. The State of West Bengal &
 Ors.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The respondents 7 and 8, it has been alleged in the writ petition, are carrying on hotel (dhaba)
business without obtaining necessary licences from the relevant authorities.
Since the respondents 7 and 8 are unrepresented despite service, it has not been possible for this Bench to ascertain as to whether they have obtained the necessary licences or not.

Learned advocates representing the petitioner and the official respondents are ad idem that licences are required to be obtained under Section 201 of the West Bengal Municipal Act, 1993 as well as under the Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Rules, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.

entities.text: Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Rules, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The Sub-Divisional Officer, Burdwan Sadar shall conduct an inquiry, upon notice to the petitioner,
to ascertain as to whether the required licences under the aforesaid statutory provisions have been obtained by the respondents 7 and 8 or not.
A report shall be filed by the sub-divisional officer on August 27, 2015, when this writ petition shall be listed once again under the heading 'To Be Mentioend'.

(DIPANKAR DATTA,J.)
